hotel.name: The St. Regis Sanya Yalong Bay Resort

verified_facts.text: The resort is surrounded by a marina and a protected mangrove forest.
verified_facts.excerpt: A marina and a protected mangrove forest surround the hotel, immersing you in natural beauty.

verified_facts.text: The resort sits on Yalong Bay with access to more than 800 meters of white sandy beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: on Yalong Bay, with access to more than 800 meters of white sandy beach and beautiful coastline

verified_facts.text: The Tropical Paradise Forest Park is right at the resort's doorstep.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Tropical Paradise Forest Park is right at your doorstep

verified_facts.text: Sanya is at the southernmost tip of Hainan.
verified_facts.excerpt: At Hainan’s southernmost tip, Sanya is often referred to as the “Hawaii of the East.”

verified_facts.text: Ming Xuan is the resort's modern Chinese restaurant, with views of the Yalong Bay Yacht Club.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savor authentic Chinese cuisine and views of the Yalong Bay Yacht Club at Ming Xuan restaurant.

verified_facts.text: Driftwood is the resort's beachside restaurant serving seafood and meats, with views of Yalong Bay.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dine on fresh, succulent seafood or perfectly cooked meats at Driftwood, our beachside restaurant with a light, airy ambiance and brilliant views of Yalong Bay.

verified_facts.text: The Drawing Room is an open-air restaurant and lounge in the resort's lobby.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in the midst of our opulent and dramatic lobby, this open-air restaurant and lounge is a vibrant gathering place.

verified_facts.text: Social serves breakfast, lunch and dinner with indoor and outdoor dining and live cooking stations.
verified_facts.excerpt: the restaurant offers indoor and outdoor dining and a lively atmosphere with live cooking stations

verified_facts.text: The Sanya Mary is the hotel's take on the bloody mary, inspired by Hainan Island and using ingredients sourced from the island.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our unique take on the traditional bloody mary inspired by Hainan Island

verified_facts.text: Iridium Spa covers 3,500 square metres and offers massage therapies, body treatments, skin care and salon services.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience the rare and extravagant at the 3,500-square-metre Iridium Spa.

verified_facts.text: The Royal Seaside Villa is a two-bedroom villa on the sea with its own pool and an outdoor dining gazebo.
verified_facts.excerpt: 2 bedroom villa right on the sea with it's own pool and outdoor dining gazebo

verified_facts.text: St. Regis Butlers offer guests one point of contact for their questions and needs.
verified_facts.excerpt: offering one point of contact to answer all of your questions and meet all of your needs

verified_facts.text: The resort has outdoor tennis courts for guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: We have outdoor tennis courts for use during your stay.

verified_facts.text: The resort has the Decanter Wine Cellar featuring wines from around the world.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join us in our exceptional wine cellar featuring outstanding wines from all over the world

verified_facts.text: The resort has a St. Regis Kid's Club.
verified_facts.excerpt: St. Regis Kid's Club

verified_facts.text: A swimming pool bubble show for kids is held every afternoon.
verified_facts.excerpt: Swimming pool bubble show every afternoon for kids

verified_facts.text: Guests can book a 30-minute in-house professional photography session with complimentary digital photos.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy 30-minute photo-taking service by one of our professional photographers

verified_facts.text: Sanya Phoenix International Airport is approximately 35 km from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: SYX is located approximately 35.0 KM from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

verified_facts.text: Pets are not allowed at the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at The St. Regis Sanya Yalong Bay Resort.

verified_facts.text: Sailing excursions, kayak tours and snorkeling trips are offered.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Sailing Excursions

Kayak Tours
